nodes.description: Public token symbol string, set to dCHF in constructor.
Public token name string, set in constructor.
Public uint8 decimals, set to 2 in constructor.
Total token supply, 1500000 units assigned to the deployer address at construction.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Current contract owner address with privileged rights.
Pending owner address for two-step ownership transfer.
Pure addition with post-condition require(c >= a) guarding overflow.
Pure subtraction guarded by require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
Pure multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Pure division guarded by require(b > 0).
Constructor setting owner to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner address in newOwner.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after verifying msg.sender == newOwner.
Modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == owner) on privileged functions.
Constructor initializing metadata, supply and initial balance, and emitting Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance held by address(0).
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a destination address using SafeMath.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to spender.
Spends an allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to'.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Approves spender then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only sweep that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership and access control.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) performed after state update in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract address.
Addition a + b inside safeAdd, overflow-guarded by require(c >= a).
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul, overflow-guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
First uint operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Second uint operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Local result variable returned by the SafeMath helpers.
Candidate address stored in newOwner by transferOwnership.
Account whose balance or allowance is queried.
Recipient address of a token transfer.
Token amount used by transfer, approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and transferAnyERC20Token.
Address granted an allowance and later called back.
Debited address in transferFrom.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary token contract address used by transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 1500000.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
Owned constructor sets owner from the caller identity.
msg.sender becomes the initial privileged owner.
transferOwnership writes the candidate owner into newOwner.
onlyOwner gates the transferOwnership privileged operation.
onlyOwner gates the arbitrary-token sweep function.
Modifier compares msg.sender against owner for authorization.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner slot.
acceptOwnership clears the pending owner address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the circulating amount.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads balances to compute the debited and credited amounts.
transfer rewrites balances after the SafeMath checks.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit source.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approve keys the allowance by msg.sender.
transferFrom updates the from and to balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is spent.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender.
approveAndCall hands control to the external spender contract through receiveApproval.
The external callback executes after the allowance write, so reentrant code can observe or alter allowance state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an attacker-chosen token contract.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner check before the sweep executes.
Parameter a is an operand of the a + b addition.
Parameter b is an operand of the a + b addition.
The addition result is stored in the local return variable c.
Parameter a is an operand of the a * b multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the a * b multiplication.
The multiplication result is stored in the local return variable c.
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd helper.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd helper.
Local c is the value returned by safeAdd.
The _newOwner parameter becomes the pending privileged owner.
tokenOwner selects the balance returned by balanceOf.
tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowance lookup.
Parameter to selects the transfer recipient.
Parameter to selects the transferFrom recipient.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value set by approve.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value set by approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded by the token sweep.
Parameter spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve.
Parameter spender becomes the externally called contract in approveAndCall.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter data is forwarded as calldata to receiveApproval.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the external contract called by the sweep.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only meaningful as an operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers and should be folded into the safeAdd core function node.
Parameter b is only meaningful as an operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers and should be folded into the safeAdd core function node.
Local c is the intermediate result of the guarded addition and belongs to the arithmetic unsafe operation node.
Parameter _newOwner exists solely to set the privileged owner and merges into transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner is the lookup key of balanceOf and merges into that view function.
Parameter to is the transfer destination and merges into the transfer function.
Parameter tokens is the moved amount and merges into the transfer function.
Parameter spender defines the allowance beneficiary and merges into approve.
Parameter from is the debited account and merges into transferFrom.
Parameter data is opaque calldata for the external callback and merges into approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the externally called token and merges into transferAnyERC20Token.
